component.name: Lumen Launcher
component.summary: Minecraft: Bedrock Edition launcher with the Lumen client

description.p: Lumen Launcher runs the Android version of Minecraft: Bedrock Edition on Linux and adds the Lumen client: in-game menu, HUD modules, server profiles and texture pack setups per server.

It is a modified version of the Minecraft Linux Launcher by the minecraft-linux project (MrARM, ChristopherHX and contributors). You need a Google account that owns Minecraft: Bedrock Edition. Your game, worlds and settings are kept in the folder Lumen in your home directory.
